therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: dopamine receptor antagonism (haloperidol/droperidol); serotonin receptor antagonism (ondansetron)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: antiemetic / nausea and pain relief in cannabinoid hyperemesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Emergency department patients with suspected cannabis hyperemesis syndrome
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in abdominal pain and nausea on 0–10 visual analog scale at 2, 24, and 48 hours

results.effect_size: At 2 hours: abdominal pain mean scores — haloperidol 4.00, droperidol 3.38, ondansetron 4.8; nausea mean scores — haloperidol 3.40, droperidol 3.69, ondansetron 5.0
safety_signals: Trial terminated due to loss to follow-up and insufficient enrollment (n=32 enrolled)

dose_info.dose: Haloperidol 5 mg IM; Droperidol 2.5 mg IV; Ondansetron 8 mg

context.comparator: Active comparator (three-arm: haloperidol vs droperidol vs ondansetron)
context.investigator_commentary: Lost too many patients to follow up, unable to enroll enough patients
